themeDescription: Delivery delays, dark store packing queues & traffic bottlenecks

challenges.title: Monsoon Rain & Waterlogged Delivery Route
challenges.shortDescription: Address a customer furious that dinner preparation is halted while the delivery rider navigates flooded city roads.
challenges.guestRole: dinner host waiting for cooking groceries
challenges.mission: Acknowledge rider weather constraints with empathy, provide accurate live tracking, and issue a late delivery goodwill voucher.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your app advertises 'Delivery in 10 Minutes'! It has been 35 minutes since I paid! My stove is on, onions are burning, and your rider is standing under a flyover according to the map! Where are my groceries?!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: accurate ETA and timely food preparation

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Questions the legitimacy of the 10-minute promise during rain.
hiddenObjectives: Check rider GPS and safety status
Provide real-time revised ETA (7 mins) and credit delay compensation wallet coupon
possibleSolutions: Real-time rider update + 100 Rs delay voucher

challenges.title: Dark Store Packing Queue Surge During Match
challenges.shortDescription: Reassure an expectant sports fan waiting for party snacks whose order was held up by dark store order surges.
challenges.mission: Explain micro-fulfillment picker queue transparently, expedite packing with dark store lead, and track priority dispatch.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: The India vs Pakistan match started 20 minutes ago and our snacks and cold drinks are still stuck on 'Order Received / Packing in Hub'! All my friends are waiting! Why hasn't a rider even been assigned?!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting drinks and chips before the first innings ends

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Urges staff to bypass queue or call hub manager.
hiddenObjectives: Ping hub captain for fast-track tote packing
Confirm rider standing by at bay
Provide updated dispatch confirmation within 3 minutes
possibleSolutions: Complimentary snack voucher on next order

challenges.title: Rider Scooter Breakdown Mid-Transit with Ice Cream
challenges.shortDescription: Coordinate immediate rider reassignment or instant fresh dispatch before premium ice cream tubs melt.
challenges.mission: Detect rider standstill, take proactive initiative to dispatch duplicate order from cold storage or reroute nearest backup rider.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Your rider's icon hasn't moved from the 100 Feet Road junction for twelve minutes. I ordered Belgian Chocolate ice cream tubs in this 38-degree summer heat! By the time he reaches, it will be liquid soup!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Points out ambient temperature and asks for immediate replacement.
hiddenObjectives: Initiate instant re-dispatch from dark store freezer bag
Guarantee replacement in insulated dry-ice tote
possibleSolutions: Full order refund if melted upon arrival

challenges.title: Emergency Midnight Infant Formula Delay
challenges.shortDescription: Treat an urgent baby milk powder order with high empathy, priority dark store rerouting, and real-time live support.
challenges.mission: Recognize human urgency of infant nourishment, personally monitor rider route, and maintain continuous active status communication.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: It's 1:30 in the morning, my 6-month-old baby is crying from hunger because our formula can ran out, and your delivery was supposed to arrive at 1:15! Please tell me your rider is almost here!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: baby formula delivered safely this second

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Pleads for real-time location update without scripted corporate delays.
hiddenObjectives: Call rider directly to verify distance (200 meters away)
Guide rider through society entry intercom
Stay on chat until doorbell rings and formula is received
